integrity: General statements are deduced in a self-contained mathematical proof. Finite exact symbolic verification only checks selected dimensions; it is not a general formal certificate. The review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex numbers and \(n\ge3\) only for irreducibility. The construction resolves the reduced affine characteristic discriminant set-theoretically identified with the ED discriminant. It does not classify singular strata, prove crepancy or smallness, or describe scheme-theoretic exceptional fibers. Older equivalent eigenline incidence descriptions could exist.
title: An isotropic-eigenline resolution of the projection-Grassmannian ED discriminant
